mapper.sql: achievement.achievement_id, achievement.management_no, achievement.teacher_user_id, owner.login_id AS teacher_name, achievement.management_item_code, achievement.achievement_date, achievement.achievement_status, detail.performance_content, detail.academic_year, CAST(detail.semester_code AS integer) AS semester, CAST(achievement.attachment_ids AS text) AS attachment_ids

FROM education_achievements achievement JOIN lecture_improvement_achievement_details detail ON detail.achievement_id = achievement.achievement_id JOIN users owner ON owner.user_id = achievement.teacher_user_id

choose.when: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_user_mappings requester_mapping JOIN organization_user_mappings target_mapping ON target_mapping.organization_code = requester_mapping.organization_code WHERE requester_mapping.user_id = #{requesterUserId} AND requester_mapping.status = 'ACTIVE' AND target_mapping.user_id = achievement.teacher_user_id AND target_mapping.status = 'ACTIVE' )

AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_organization_mappings permission_mapping JOIN organization_user_mappings target_mapping ON target_mapping.organization_code = permission_mapping.organization_code WHERE permission_mapping.user_id = #{requesterUserId} AND permission_mapping.business_type = 'FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' AND permission_mapping.data_scope IN ('DEPARTMENT', 'COLLEGE', 'BUSINESS', 'ALL') AND target_mapping.user_id = achievement.teacher_user_id AND target_mapping.status = 'ACTIVE' )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM education_achievements achievement WHERE achievement.achievement_type = 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT' AND achievement.deleted_yn = 'N'

WHERE achievement.achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND achievement.achievement_type = 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT' AND achievement.deleted_yn = 'N'

SELECT achievement.achievement_id FROM education_achievements achievement WHERE achievement.management_no = #{managementNo} AND achievement.achievement_type = 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT' AND achievement.deleted_yn = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM education_achievements achievement WHERE achievement.achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND achievement.achievement_type = 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT' AND achievement.deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievements ( management_no, achievement_type, teacher_user_id, evaluation_year, management_item_code, achievement_date, attachment_ids, achievement_status, deleted_yn, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{managementNo}, 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT', #{teacherUserId}, #{evaluationYear}, #{managementItemCode}, #{achievementDate}, CAST(#{attachmentIds} AS jsonb), 'DRAFT', 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdBy} )

INSERT INTO lecture_improvement_achievement_details ( achievement_id, performance_content, academic_year, semester_code, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{achievementId}, #{achievementContent}, #{academicYear}, #{semesterCode}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET evaluation_year = #{evaluationYear}, management_item_code = #{managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{achievementDate}, attachment_ids = CAST(#{attachmentIds} AS jsonb), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND achievement_type = 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT' AND deleted_yn = 'N'

UPDATE lecture_improvement_achievement_details SET performance_content = #{achievementContent}, academic_year = #{academicYear}, semester_code = #{semesterCode}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievement_status_histories ( achievement_type, achievement_id, previous_status, next_status, action_type, opinion, processed_by ) VALUES ( 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT', #{achievementId}, NULL, 'DRAFT', 'CREATE', '강의개선 실적 최초 입력', #{processedBy} )

INSERT INTO data_change_histories ( target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason ) VALUES ( #{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason} )
